_schema_docs.schema_version: integer — current cache schema version (FR-6). v1 shipped in M013/P01. Increment on any breaking per-item shape change.
_schema_docs.repo_slug: string — 'owner/repo' for the target GitHub repo. 'pending' until operator completes init.
_schema_docs.project_v2_id: string — GitHub Projects v2 node ID. 'pending' until init (P02) creates or attaches.
_schema_docs.sync_mode: enum: manual|on-transition|cron — how sync is invoked.
_schema_docs.sub_issue_mode: enum: native|labeled-fallback|pending — GitHub sub-issue REST availability mode recorded by P02 init preflight. 'pending' until init probes /repos/:slug/issues/1/sub_issues. 'native' = GitHub sub-issue REST used. 'labeled-fallback' = parent:<phase-id> / child:<task-id> labels + reciprocal body links used. See references/github-integration.md § Sub-Issue Representation Modes.
_schema_docs.recommended_cron: string — cron expression surfaced to the operator when sync_mode=cron. Advisory only; orchestrator does not install cron.
_schema_docs.custom_field_mappings: array — optional operator-declared Project v2 custom-field name→orchestrator-source mappings.
_schema_docs.items: object — per-item cache keyed by orchestrator-id (e.g. 'M013-P01', 'M013-P01-T01'). Per-item shape: {issue_number: int, project_v2_attached: bool, status_field_synced: bool, last_attempt_at: iso8601-string, last_error: string|null, schema_version: int}. Populated by P02 on first init; empty {} at P01 scaffold.
